vocabulary.note_ar: يقال أيضًا go straight on (بريطانية) أو go straight ahead
vocabulary.note_en: Also "go straight on" (UK) or "go straight ahead".

vocabulary.meaning_en: walk or drive beside something and continue
very near, at the side of

vocabulary.example: The station is opposite the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place that keeps money for people
the place where two streets meet
a polite way to get someone's attention
vocabulary.example: Excuse me, where is the station?
Is there a bank near here?
Is it far? - No, it's near.

fine_lines.title: next to / opposite
fine_lines.explanation_ar: next to تعني بجانبه مباشرة على نفس الجهة، و opposite تعني في الجهة المقابلة ووجهًا لوجه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Next to" means beside. "Opposite" means on the other side, facing.

examples.sentence: The café is next to the bank.
The station is opposite the park.

fine_lines.title: go straight / turn
fine_lines.explanation_ar: go straight تعني الاستمرار في نفس الاتجاه، و turn تعني تغيير الاتجاه يمينًا أو يسارًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Go straight" means keep going the same way. "Turn" means change direction.

examples.sentence: Go straight to the end of the road.

fine_lines.title: go past / go to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: go past تعني المرور بجانب المكان ومتابعة السير، أما go to فتعني الذهاب إليه والوصول.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Go past" means pass it and continue. "Go to" means arrive there.

examples.sentence: Go past the school and turn left.
Go to the school and wait there.

expressions.meaning_en: say you don't know where you are
expressions.example: Excuse me, I'm lost. Can you help me?

expressions.meaning_en: ask the way to a place
expressions.example: Excuse me, where is the train station?

expressions.meaning_en: tell someone to continue the same way
tell someone to pass a place
expressions.example: Go past the school and the park.
The bank is next to the supermarket.
The hospital is opposite the park.

grammar.title: Imperatives for directions
grammar.explanation_ar: لإعطاء التوجيهات نستخدم صيغة الأمر: الفعل في بداية الجملة بدون فاعل: Go straight. Turn left. Go past the school.
grammar.explanation_en: To give directions, use the imperative: start with the verb and no subject.
examples: Go past the school, and turn right.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place: next to, opposite
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم it's + حرف جر لوصف مكان الشيء: It's next to the bank. It's opposite the park.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "It's + preposition + place" to say where something is.
examples: The café is next to the school.

questions.question: You don't know where you are. You say: "I'm ___."
questions.explanation_en: "Lost" means you don't know where you are.

questions.question: "It's opposite the park" means ...
choices: it's on the other side, facing the park
questions.explanation_en: "Opposite" means on the other side, facing it.

questions.question: Go ___ the school and turn left.
The café is ___ the bank. (beside it)
How do you politely start a question to a stranger?
questions.explanation_ar: Excuse me طريقة مهذبة لبدء الكلام.

questions.question: "Go straight" means ...
questions.explanation_ar: go straight = استمر في نفس الاتجاه.
questions.explanation_en: "Go straight" means continue the same way.

questions.question: Which word is a place where two streets meet?
questions.explanation_en: A corner is where two streets meet.
